description: This Java source file defines the MediaHandler class, which manages storage and retrieval of complex media data (audio/video) for observations in the OpenMRS system. It implements methods for fetching media data, supporting specific views, and saving media content to a file system, utilizing MIME type detection and logging.

classes.name: MediaHandler
classes.description: A handler class for storing and retrieving complex media data (audio/video) associated with observations in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieves media data associated with an observation for the RAW_VIEW, loading data from storage and inferring MIME type.

methods.name: getSupportedViews
methods.description: Returns the list of supported view types for this handler, currently only RAW_VIEW.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Saves the complex media data of an observation to storage and updates the observation with a reference key.
